guidelines.detail: documentation rule FID-01 not applied (The description states that registration precedes the supervisor receiving the request, and the reference includes a registration task that is absent from the generated model. FID-01 already says to model every distinct activity stated in the description.)

refines FID-02 (The description distinguishes submission from a later registration before the request is received, but the generated task corresponding to submission has no separate counterpart for registration. FID-02 already says to preserve separately described actions and their dependencies; this guideline makes that application more specific.)

same as LRN-048 (The description places a completed action before the supervisor receives the request, and the generated model omits the corresponding activity. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-048.)
same as LRN-060 (The label pairs show paraphrases that can shift the described action, while the description provides the intended actions and outcomes. LRN-060 already expresses this guideline.)

same as LRN-089 (The description places registration before the request is received, and the reference contains a registration task with no counterpart in the generated model. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-089.)

same as LRN-060 (The label pairs show a shift from the described action “submits” to “Register” (P2), while the description confirms the intended action (S1). This guideline is already stated essentially the same way in learned guideline LRN-060; documented guideline FID-03 also broadly calls for faithful labels.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an item is registered before another participant handles it

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an item is submitted and separately registered before it is handled by another participant: Model submission and registration as distinct activities, in the stated order, before the subsequent handling activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an item is submitted and separately registered before it is handled by another participant

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly states an action performed by a participant before subsequent process work: Model that action as a BPMN activity and include it in the sequence flow.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an action has been completed before a subsequent process step, even if it is not phrased as an instruction

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with wording that preserves the described action and its object or result; do not substitute a related but different action or outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a specific action or outcome for a modeled element
